verdict.rationale: Sketch is a design platform with a web workspace and developer integrations, so scoped API credentials for agents is a fair question to ask. The evidence shows only a local-only MCP server, a plugin JavaScript API, permissions groups, SSO and SCIM for human users, and "no tokens" in the sense of no AI usage tokens to buy. None of this documents issuing scoped or least-privilege API credentials to an agent; permissions groups are an adjacent user-access control, not agent credentials.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can issue scoped/least-privilege API credentials for an agent
